# Vulcx

> Vulcx is a DEX aggregator and swap-routing engine for Fogo Chain. Give it a token
> pair and an amount; it searches every pool on Fogo — up to five hops, splitting
> across pools when splitting wins — and returns a transaction you can sign.

## Endpoints

Base URL: https://api.vulcx.xyz

- `GET /api/v1/quote` — best route and estimated output for a pair
- `POST /api/v1/swap` — a ready-to-sign transaction
- `POST /api/v1/instructions` — raw instructions, for callers assembling their own transaction
- `GET /api/v1/price` — spot/mid USD price derived from live pool state
- `wss://api.vulcx.xyz/api/v1/stream` — WebSocket quote stream (this one requires a key)

Rate limits are set by plan and shared by every key on an account, debited by
request cost rather than request count. A key is optional on REST — anonymous
callers get a small per-IP budget — and required for the WebSocket stream, which
needs a plan from Starter up. Get a key (self-serve, Google or GitHub sign-in) at
https://portal.vulcx.xyz; plans at https://portal.vulcx.xyz/pricing/.
Full reference: https://docs.vulcx.xyz

## Liquidity sources

Valiant (concentrated liquidity) and Fluxbeam (constant product and bonding
curve). Routes report these as the wire values `Vortex` and `Flux`.

## Status

Live checks against the production endpoints: https://vulcx.xyz/status/
(API health and a real quote, run from the visitor's browser).
